title: Procreate Fashion Body Pose Stamps
author: sundrameda
description:
20 Realistic Body Poses Stamps for Procreate to help you with painting:) Save your time!
💌 INCLUDED:
– 20 Realistic Body Poses Stamps for Procreate
⚙️TECHNICAL:
– Apple Ipad
– Procreate App for iPad
❗️IMPORTANT:These brushes are compatible only with PROCREATE for iPad. They won’t work in Photoshop or other painting programs.
How to Install Procreate Brushes:
If you downloaded the files on your iPad:
1. Open the Files app and locate the downloaded ZIP file.
2. Tap the ZIP file to unzip it.
3. Open the extracted folder and tap the .brushset file.
4. The brush set will be automatically imported into Procreate.
5. Open the Brush Library – the new brush set will appear at the top of the list.
If you downloaded the files on your computer:
1. Unzip the downloaded ZIP file.
2. Transfer the .brushset file to your iPad using AirDrop, iCloud Drive, email, or another cloud service.
3. Open the file on your iPad and tap the .brushset file to import it into Procreate.
